request.style: English, traditional church hymn, four-part SATB choir, pipe organ, soft strings, stately and reverent, steady hymn meter, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Upon the night he was betrayed
Within the upper room
The Lord sat down among his friends
Beneath the gathering gloom
He took a basin and a towel
And knelt upon the floor
The Teacher and the Lord of all
Washed feet and asked no more

[Verse]
He took the bread and gave God thanks
And broke it, saying, Take
He passed the cup of covenant
Poured out for sinners' sake
I will not drink this fruit again
He told the twelve that night
Until I drink it new with you
In my Father's kingdom bright

[Verse]
This is my body, given for you
In remembrance of me
This cup, the covenant made new
Do this remembering me
As often as you eat this bread
And drink this cup of grace
You tell the death the Lord has died
Until you see his face

[Verse]
They sang a hymn and rose to go
Out to the olive hill
The Lamb walked out into the night
To do his Father's will
And still we gather at his word
To share the bread and cup
Until he comes, the risen Lord
To lift his people up

[Outro]
Do this in remembrance of me
